summary: Neighborhood Intelligence, Inc. (formerly Beyond/Bed Bath & Beyond) filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its Capital on Demand at-the-market sales agreement with JonesTrading, cutting the ATM program's maximum aggregate offering price from $200 million to $75 million, alongside a registered direct offering of 10,881,192 common shares and pre-funded warrants for 5,241,997 shares, plus accompanying common warrants covering 16,123,189 shares, at $2.76 per share/warrant unit ($2.759 per pre-funded unit). This is a routine shelf takedown and capital raise, not a special situation.
